title: Manticore Search 27.1.5: Auth, sharding, conversational and faster vector search
summary: Manticore Search released version 27.1.5 with significant new features including built-in authentication, sharding capabilities for horizontal scaling, conversational search functionality for AI-powered queries, and improved vector search performance.
problem_solved: Enables production-ready deployment with security (auth), scalability (sharding), and AI integration (conversational search) capabilities for full-text and vector search workloads.
why_valuable: Combines traditional full-text search with modern vector search capabilities, offering a unified solution for building AI-powered search applications with improved performance and enterprise features.
